en-US.title: Technically!
en-US.subtitle: The party game of being right
en-US.description:
Argue first. Find out who's right.

Technically! is a pass-and-play party game for people who love being right about ridiculous things. Every question has two answers: the one everyone assumes, and the one that's technically true.

How many legs does a crab have? Is a tomato a fruit? Which planet is closest to Earth? Make your case, then find out who was right.

HOW IT WORKS
• Debate your take: argue it out before the timer runs out.
• Pass the phone: everyone secretly locks in A or B.
• See the real answer: right answers score points, and siding with the minority earns an underdog bonus.
• Learn fun facts: every answer comes with the story behind it.

FEATURES
• Nearly 200 surprising questions across Animals, Science, Space, Food, History, and Myths
• 1 to 8 players on a single phone
• Adjustable debate timer and game length
• Questions you've already played are saved for later, so games stay fresh
• No accounts, no ads, no tracking

Smart. Silly. Seriously fun.
en-US.promoText: Argue first. Find out who's right. Nearly 200 questions with a surprising answer.
